comment: MACD(12,26,9) structural fixture. Exact hand-computed values for 26+ candles are error-prone by hand, so this fixture pins the STRUCTURE that catches the classic bug: (1) macd line = ema(fast) - ema(slow), aligned to input with leading nulls = slow-1; (2) the SIGNAL LINE MUST BE AN EMA OF THE MACD LINE, NOT OF PRICE. The test script recomputes both independently and asserts signal === ema(macdLineValues, 9). Closes are a deterministic pseudo-random ramp.
